note: Festival rules, looked up by the calendar. Not used by any gameplay yet. Dates are Nisan-based months and days; they are separate from the canonical-event timeline.

pentecost.note: Leviticus 23:15-16 counts fifty days from 'the morrow after the sabbath'. Which sabbath was disputed in the period, so both readings are provided and the choice is configuration, not a settled fact.

pharisaic.label: The sabbath is the Passover day: count from 16 Nisan.

sadducean.label: The sabbath is the weekly Sabbath in Unleavened Bread: count from the Sunday after it.
